config.dinosaurs.title: Dinosaurs
config.dinosaurs.hostile_daylight.toolti: When OFF, T-Rex, Velociraptor, Spinosaurus and Megalodon only spawn at night, in darkness (light level 7 or less).
config.dinosaurs.frequency.tooltip: Multiplies every species' spawn weight (100% = default, 200% = twice as common, 0% = no natural spawns). Applies after re-joining the world or restarting the server.
config.dinosaurs.weight.tooltip: How often this dinosaur spawns in its biomes, compared with other mobs there (cow, sheep, pig: 10-12; default %s; 0 = never). Applies after re-joining the world or restarting the server.
config.dinosaurs.restart_note: Weights apply after re-joining the world (or restarting the server). The on/off switches work at once.
config.dinosaurs.spawn.tooltip: Natural spawning of this dinosaur. Spawn eggs, spawners and /summon always work.

modmenu.descriptionTranslation.dinosaurs: Adds well-known dinosaurs as new mobs. Each species spawns in its own biomes; carnivores are hostile, herbivores are passive or neutral. Craft an Amulet of Dino Protection, a saddle to ride a Triceratops, a T-Rex Skull Helmet, a Dinosaur Bone Bow, Dinosaur Armor, the Dinosaur Claw gauntlet and a Dino Collar that makes a T-Rex your companion.
item.dinosaurs.guide_book.desc: Right-click to read about every dinosaur
book.dinosaurs.intro: Every dinosaur: how it looks, where it lives and what it drops. Plus every recipe.
book.dinosaurs.index_hint: Click an item in a recipe to open its page. Drag a dinosaur picture to turn it.
book.dinosaurs.settings.daylight: Hostile dinosaurs can spawn in daylight. When OFF, they spawn only at night, in the dark.
book.dinosaurs.settings.how: Change it in dinosaurs.json (config folder) or with Mod Menu + Cloth Config. On a server, the server's file counts.
book.dinosaurs.stats.heading: Stats
book.dinosaurs.dino.t_rex: Hostile. The king of predators: huge, tough and hits very hard. Attacks players on sight.
book.dinosaurs.habitat.t_rex: Plains, Sunflower Plains, Forest and Dark Forest. Always alone and rare: at most one in a 64-block area. Needs open sky. Never on Peaceful.
book.dinosaurs.dino.velociraptor: Hostile. Small and very fast. Hunts in packs: hit one and the whole pack comes for you.
book.dinosaurs.habitat.velociraptor: Savanna, Savanna Plateau, Windswept Savanna, Badlands, Wooded Badlands and Eroded Badlands. Packs of 2-4 under open sky. Never on Peaceful.
book.dinosaurs.dino.spinosaurus: Hostile. A giant hunter with a sail on its back. Happily wades through water to reach you.
book.dinosaurs.habitat.spinosaurus: Mangrove Swamp and Beach. Always alone: at most one in a 64-block area, under open sky. Never on Peaceful.
book.dinosaurs.dino.megalodon: Hostile. A gigantic prehistoric shark. It only hunts players in the water, so use a boat!
book.dinosaurs.habitat.megalodon: Deep Ocean, Deep Cold, Deep Lukewarm and Deep Frozen Ocean, at least 10 blocks below sea level. Very rare: one in a 96-block area. Never on Peaceful.
book.dinosaurs.dino.triceratops: Neutral. Leaves you alone until hit, then charges with its horns. Saddle it to ride it.
book.dinosaurs.habitat.triceratops: Plains, Sunflower Plains and Meadow. Herds of 2-3 on grass, in bright light. Plant-eaters never despawn, like cows.
book.dinosaurs.dino.stegosaurus: Neutral. A calm plant-eater with back plates and a spiked tail. Hit one and the herd fights back.
book.dinosaurs.habitat.stegosaurus: Forest, Flower Forest, Birch Forest and Old Growth Birch Forest. Groups of 1-3 on grass, in bright light.
book.dinosaurs.dino.ankylosaurus: Neutral. A living tank: very thick armor and a club tail. Fights back when attacked.
book.dinosaurs.habitat.ankylosaurus: Taiga, Old Growth Pine Taiga, Old Growth Spruce Taiga, Windswept Hills, Windswept Forest and Windswept Gravelly Hills. Groups of 1-2 on grass, in bright light.
book.dinosaurs.dino.brachiosaurus: Passive. The biggest dinosaur, with a very long neck. Never attacks; runs from attackers and carnivores.
book.dinosaurs.habitat.brachiosaurus: Jungle, Sparse Jungle and Bamboo Jungle. Groups of 1-2 on grass, in bright light.
book.dinosaurs.dino.parasaurolophus: Passive. A duck-billed plant-eater with a long head crest. Runs from attackers and carnivores.
book.dinosaurs.habitat.parasaurolophus: Swamp and River. Herds of 2-4 on grass, in bright light.
book.dinosaurs.dino.pteranodon: Passive flying reptile. Glides around, then perches on the highest point nearby. Flees when hurt.
book.dinosaurs.habitat.pteranodon: Windswept Hills, Windswept Gravelly Hills, Stony Peaks and Jagged Peaks. Groups of 1-3 under open sky, in bright light.
book.dinosaurs.item.guide_book: This book. Shapeless: Book + Leather + any dinosaur trophy (tooth, claw, hide or crest). Right-click to read.
book.dinosaurs.item.amulet_of_dino_prote: Keep it in your inventory (or the Trinkets necklace slot) and hostile dinosaurs ignore you. Attack one and it may fight back.
book.dinosaurs.item.dinosaur_saddle: Use it on a Triceratops, then right-click to ride and steer. Sneak with an empty hand to take it off.
book.dinosaurs.item.dino_collar: Carry the amulet and use the collar on a T-Rex: it follows you, fights for you, ignores other players unless they hit you, and never despawns. Sneak + empty hand: sit / follow. Meat heals it.
book.dinosaurs.item.t_rex_tooth: 1-2 from every Tyrannosaurus Rex, more with Looting. Part of the amulet, the Dinosaur Claw and the Dino Collar (3).
book.dinosaurs.item.raptor_claw: Up to 1 from a Velociraptor, more with Looting. The amulet and the Dinosaur Claw need 2. Also makes Dinosaur Boots.
book.dinosaurs.item.megalodon_tooth: 1-3 from a Megalodon, more with Looting. Part of the amulet and of the Dinosaur Chestplate.
book.dinosaurs.item.brachiosaurus_hide: 1-3 from a Brachiosaurus, more with Looting. Makes the saddle, or 2 Leather.
book.dinosaurs.item.parasaurolophus_cres: Up to 1 from a Parasaurolophus, more with Looting. Part of the saddle and of the Dinosaur Leggings.
book.dinosaurs.item.dinosaur_bones: Large dinosaurs drop these instead of bones, more with Looting. For the Bone Bow, the Claw, the Upgrade or 4 Bone Meal.
book.dinosaurs.item.dinosaur_bone_bow: Faster draw, faster arrows that hit harder. Infinity and Mending work together on it! Enchantments from the bow are kept.
book.dinosaurs.item.t_rex_skull: Rare: 4% of T. rexes killed by a player drop one, up to 10% with Looting. Craft it with Leather and a Netherite Ingot into a helmet.
book.dinosaurs.item.t_rex_skull_helmet: Wear a T. rex skull on your head. Fire resistant like netherite. Repair it with a Netherite Ingot or a T-Rex Skull.
book.dinosaurs.item.dinosaur_upgrade_smi: Smithing template that turns netherite chestplate, leggings and boots into Dinosaur Armor. Used up like the Netherite Upgrade. 7 Dinosaur Bones and a Bone Block copy it.
book.dinosaurs.item.dinosaur_claw: A clawed gauntlet: hits harder than a netherite sword, but its reach is 0.5 shorter. Sword enchantments. Fire resistant. Repair: Dinosaur Bones.
book.dinosaurs.item.dinosaur_armor: Enchantments stay. Better than netherite in every stat. Repair: Dinosaur Bones. Helmet: T-Rex Skull Helmet.
